title: Deleting
body: The first thing this app does is ask for your email address, but I wanted to explore its features first before committing to anything. All I could access was a daily affirmation and links to other apps. And it kept sending me to a web page that doesn’t exist. I couldn’t find anything useful, and it all feels a bit dodgy so I’m deleting immediately. Maybe it’s more useful if you sign up but I wasn’t prepared to do that.

title: What the hell
body: I just paid for an app to see “something is better than nothing!” 😂 all i got was one quote, how is this curing my adhd, how is this helping me organise my daily routine, how is this helpful i could literally get that from a tiktok i cant believe i paid money for absolutely no info nothing. Just sends you to other apps thats it. Want my money back asap
